articles.author: Piero Cingari
articles.headline: Wall Street Gave Up on PayPal, But the Stock Just Had Its Best Day Ever
articles.summary: PayPal shares jumped 17.2% on a reported $60.50-a-share bid from Stripe and Advent. Down 85% from 2021 highs, the discount is what drew buyers in.
articles._summary: A payments company that has lost more than 80% of its value in five years just posted the largest single-day gain of its eleven-year public life . PayPal Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: PYPL ) rose 17.19% on Wednesday, the biggest daily rally since the company’s 2015 spin-off. What Happened: Reuters reported that Stripe Inc. and Advent International Corp. submitted a joint proposal earlier this month at $60.50 a share, valuing PayPal at more than $53 billion.
articles._zh_headline: 华尔街放弃了 PayPal，但该股刚刚经历了有史以来最好的一天
articles._zh_summary: 一家在五年内市值损失超过 80% 的支付公司刚刚公布了其 11 年上市以来最大的单日涨幅。 PayPal Holdings Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：PYPL）周三上涨 17.19%，这是该公司 2015 年分拆以来的最大单日涨幅。发生了什么：据路透社报道，Stripe Inc. 和 Advent International Corp. 本月早些时候提交了一份联合提案，每股价格为 60.50 美元，对 PayPal 的估值超过 530 亿美元。

articles.author: Chris Katje
articles.headline: Warren Buffett Looks for Value in Today’s Market But Comes Up Empty: ‘Everybody Is Preferring Gambling’
articles.summary: Warren Buffett is still looking for value when it comes to stocks. The legendary investor says it's getting harder to find value stocks these days.
articles._summary: That $397 billion continues to sit on the sidelines as stocks hit record highs across many sectors. Buffett said he fails to see value in many investments and thinks the stock market is getting closer to a casino. "It’s tough to find values when everybody is preferring gambling," Buffett told CNBC Wednesday. The legendary investor said the market today is driven more by speculative trading and not long-term investing.

articles.headline: Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh's testimony to Senate banking committee hits on economy, interest rates
articles.summary: Part of congressionally mandated Capitol Hill appearances for the central bank leader, Warsh spoke Tuesday to the House Financial Services Committee.
articles._summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh testified Wednesday before the Senate Banking Committee, facing questions over the the economy and how various factors might impact interest rates. Part of congressionally mandated Capitol Hill appearances for the central bank leader, Warsh spoke Tuesday to the House Financial Services Committee. During his remarks, he reaffirmed the Fed's commitment to fighting inflation though he gave few clues about the direction of monetary policy. Legislators tried baiting Warsh into commenting on fiscal and political matters, but he largely avoided the topics, stressing the importance of the Fed staying focused on its assigned responsibilities.
articles._zh_headline: 美联储主席凯文·沃什向参议院银行委员会作证对经济和利率造成打击
articles._zh_summary: 美联储主席凯文·沃什周三在参议院银行委员会作证，面临有关经济以及各种因素如何影响利率的问题。作为国会授权央行行长出席国会山的一部分，沃什周二向众议院金融服务委员会发表了讲话。在讲话中，他重申了美联储对抗通胀的承诺，尽管他没有透露有关货币政策方向的任何线索。立法者试图引诱沃什就财政和政治问题发表评论，但他基本上回避了这些话题，强调美联储专注于其指定职责的重要性。

articles.headline: Buffett says Trump's pick of Kevin Warsh for Fed chair was 'good choice'
articles.summary: Warren Buffett believes Fed Chair Kevin Warsh will do the best job he can.
articles._summary: New Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh was a "good choice" for the job, Warren Buffett told CNBC. Warsh made his mark during his first meeting as chair in June, holding rates steady while outlining changes to the central bank's approach . In Congressional testimony on Tuesday, Warsh pledged a " regime change " in Fed policy and promised to tackle inflation. "I think he will do the best he can at achieving the job he was assigned to do, which is 2% inflation and maintaining maximum employment," Buffett said in an interview with Becky Quick on " Squawk Box ." "He can't be perfect at it, and just like I know I couldn't be perfect at taking people's money and earning super returns on it," he added. Warsh took the helm in May after being nominated by President Donald Trump and confirmed by Congress. On Wednesday, he'll return to the Capitol to testify in front of the Senate Banking Committee.
articles._zh_headline: 巴菲特表示特朗普选择凯文·沃什担任美联储主席是“不错的选择”
articles._zh_summary: 沃伦·巴菲特对 CNBC 表示，新任美联储主席凯文·沃什是这一职位的“不错选择”。沃什在 6 月份作为主席的第一次会议上留下了自己的印记，他保持利率稳定，同时概述了央行政策的变化。在周二的国会证词中，沃什承诺对美联储政策进行“政权更迭”，并承诺解决通胀问题。巴菲特在“Squawk Box”节目中接受贝基·奎克采访时表示：“我认为他将尽最大努力完成分配给他的工作，即 2% 的通胀率和保持最大就业。”他补充道：“他在这方面不可能做到完美，就像我知道我在拿走人们的钱并从中赚取超额回报方面也无法做到完美一样。”沃什在由唐纳德·特朗普总统提名并得到国会确认后于五月上任。周三，他将返回国会大厦，在参议院银行委员会面前作证。

articles.summary: Anthropic's Claude has grown its website traffic share nearly sixfold in a year, overtaking several AI rivals as ChatGPT's dominance gradually eases.
articles._summary: The AI traffic leaderboard still belongs to ChatGPT, which held a commanding 52.7% share in June despite slipping from 76.4% a year earlier. Google’s Gemini has emerged as the clear No. 2, climbing from 9.1% to 27.8% over the same period. Claude’s traffic share has nearly doubled in just the past three months, rising from 8.0% in March to 9.2% in June. That rapid growth has widened its lead over competitors including DeepSeek (3.6%), Grok (2.5%), Microsoft Copilot (2.0%) and Perplexity (1.1%).

articles._zh_summary: 消息公布后，Twin Vee 周一常规交易日收盘价为 24.86 美元，涨幅为 415.77%。根据市场数据，Twin Vee PowerCats 的市值维持在约 1316 万美元。该股 52 周交易价格区间为 4.22 美元至 128.02 美元。过去12个月，VEEE股价下跌54.75%。在宣布重组之前，Twin Vee PowerCats 的业务重点是休闲船只的制造。

articles.headline: These 10 Stocks Rallied as Producer Inflation Plunged: Here's Why
articles.summary: PPI fell 0.3% in June, the softest since April 2025. Gold miners, BlackRock and Bank of Nova Scotia topped the large-cap pre-market board. Here's why.
articles._summary: Three gold miners, two asset-management giants and a high-flying semiconductor were among the large-cap movers on the pre-market board following a cooler-than-expected producer inflation report on Wednesday. Producer prices fell 0.3% in June, the softest monthly print since April 2025, a day after consumer inflation posted its steepest monthly decline since April 2020.
articles._zh_headline: 随着生产者通胀暴跌，这 10 只股票上涨：原因如下
articles._zh_summary: 在周三发布低于预期的生产者通胀报告后，三大黄金矿商、两家资产管理巨头和一家雄心勃勃的半导体公司成为盘前板块中大盘股的推动者。 6 月份生产者价格下跌 0.3%，为 2025 年 4 月以来最疲软的月度数据，而前一天消费者通胀则创下 2020 年 4 月以来最大幅度的月度跌幅。

articles.author: Daragh Thomas
articles.headline: Apple Intelligence Finally Cleared for China: Here's Which Stocks Are Popping on the News
articles.summary: China approved Apple Intelligence Wednesday, sending Alibaba stock higher as its Qwen AI model powers the long-delayed rollout on iPhones.
articles._summary: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ: AAPL ) received Chinese regulatory approval for Apple Intelligence on Wednesday, ending a wait that began with the feature’s launch in 2024. Alibaba Group Holding (NYSE: BABA ) , whose Qwen model will power the service, rose more than 4% in premarket trading. Apple gained close to 1%. The Cyberspace Administration of China added Apple’s generative AI services to its list of approved providers, according to a post on the regulator’s website.
articles._zh_headline: 苹果情报终于为中国清除了：以下是新闻中出现的股票
articles._zh_summary: 苹果公司（纳斯达克股票代码：AAPL）周三获得了中国监管机构对 Apple Intelligence 的批准，结束了自 2024 年推出该功能以来的等待。阿里巴巴集团控股公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BABA）的 Qwen 模型将为该服务提供动力，该公司在盘前交易中股价上涨超过 4%。苹果股价上涨近 1%。据监管机构网站上的一篇帖子称，中国国家互联网信息办公室已将苹果的生成式人工智能服务添加到其批准的提供商名单中。
